notes: Shorthand notes + POC checklist. Hosted API trial summary: baseline traffic stable, peaks correlated with morning digest job. Metrics observed: average QPS ~12, peak QPS observed ~72 (weekday morning spike), average concurrent streams observed ~28, peak concurrency ~46. Token profile: average tokens per request ~180 (prompt ~110 / completion ~70). Token mix: ~70% short interactions (<64 tokens total), ~25% medium (128-512 tokens), ~5% long-context (>1024 tokens). Observed latency: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~410ms on Hosted for typical chat model. Requirements from product: p95 < 300ms for short chat flows; tolerate up to 1.5s for long-context generations. Throughput target: support sustained 40-50 concurrent streams with peaks up to 75 QPS; target baseline capacity supports ~13.5k tokens/sec at peak (75 QPS * 180 tokens avg). Cost sensitivity: high — CFO said 'need predictable unit economics before committing' and wants ~30-40% per-token cost improvement on Dedicated compared to Hosted run-rate. Model preferences: prefer open/quantized LLM variants for cost (13B quantized for main path, 7B fallback). Routing/fallback: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU secondary), automatic downgrade to smaller model on capacity pressure. Security: must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 Type II evidence, audit logs retained 12 months, KMS/HSM integration, and EU data residency for EU tenant records. Dedicated POC ask: mirror 10% production traffic for two weeks, run ramp to 1.5x observed peak, run latency and correctness regressions, provide kernel/quantization config suggestions. Suggested Dedicated sizing (initial proposal): baseline reserved pool 4 x A10G-equivalent GPUs (model & batch tuned) with autoscale up to 8 GPUs for burst; rationale: observed per-GPU throughput ~1.6k tokens/sec for chosen quantized 13B variant -> 4 GPUs ~6.4k tokens/sec baseline, 2x headroom = 8 GPUs to comfortably handle peaks and growth. Alternate config: 2 x A100 or equivalent for higher single-GPU throughput if they prefer fewer machines. Ops asks: detailed network diagram for VPC onboarding, egress path and firewall rules, SOC2 artifact bundle, encryption-at-rest proof. Pricing asks: committed discount tiers, clear burst/overage policy, pricing for multi-region fallback. Blockers: procurement timeline ~8-10 weeks (budget & contract), legal concerns around EU data residency clause and vendor subprocessor list, need formal benchmark numbers on Dedicated vs Hosted under mirrored load. Next steps: run Dedicated sizing workshop (Dec week 1), follow-up pricing deck and SOW draft, schedule legal + security deep dive with security docs attached.
